Source-led guide

Check a small finance report with Claude

Find a duplicate, explain a variance and reconcile two tiny files.

eligible paid Claude accessbrowsersynthetic files linked below
Step 01

Get the practice files

Download sample.csv, bank.csv and ledger.csv. These are fictional amounts.

Ready when: No company data or account connection.

Step 02

Add Finance

In Claude, open Customize, then Plugins, Discover. Select Anthropic's Finance plugin and click Add.

Ready when: Finance appears among your plugins.

Step 03

Check the variance

Attach sample.csv in a fresh chat. Ask: "Find duplicate IDs first. Deduplicate identical rows. Calculate revenue minus expenses for budget and actual, then explain the profit variance. Do not invent drivers."

Ready when: Duplicate E2; profit moves from 4,000 to 4,500.

Step 04

Reconcile the files

In a fresh chat, attach bank.csv and ledger.csv. Select reconciliation from the / menu. Ask for unmatched IDs, mismatched amounts and both net totals.

Ready when: T3 differs; bank 500, ledger 550.

Check your result

  • Compare with expected totals.
  • Profit rises 500 (12.5%); bank minus ledger is -50.
Fix or undo
  • Missing plugin? Check your plan or organisation policy.
  • To undo, remove practice chats/files and the plugin if unwanted.
Source, date and review limits

Inspired by Nicolas Boucher's finance-plugin tutorial: captions and four frames reviewed; workflow untested. Official setup; Finance scope. Fixture arithmetic was checked separately. Real reporting needs qualified review. Account cost varies; no financial advice or accuracy guarantee.
